title: gep's Vanilla+
description: A Minecraft modpack designed to provide nice quality of life upgrades to vanilla with sensible defaults. Includes FPS boosting optimizations that do not affect core gameplay.
body:
Adds quality of life and optimization mods. Simple to use with great defaults.


- Efficient distant rendering
- Easy sorting (Press R)
- Pin items to not sort (Press and hold alt, then click items in inventory)
- Waypoints (Press U)
- Access map (Press M)
- Safely place blocks adjacent to other blocks (Bridging mod)
- Over-the-Shoulder Third Person
